checkpointPayload.title: Sync x-request-id counter to prevent server rejection, fix auto-claim UI update, and implement inventory grid view for items

taskChanges.newValue: Synced x-request-id counter globally between Unity game client and extension RPC dispatches via sessionStorage and xhr.setRequestHeader rewrite, preventing 'Request id less then cached request id' server error. Fixed auto-claim UI update with unconditional api-record dispatch and optimistic popup cache refresh. Implemented inventory-style borderless grid view for tab Items with group dividers sorted in-game order (consumables, equipment, recipes, soul stones, resources), item abbreviations on top-left, quantities on bottom-right, full tooltips, and grid/list view switcher (persisted, defaulting to grid). Version bumped to v0.9.31.
